question.question: The leaf cells of a flowering plant have 20 chromosomes. How many chromosomes will its primary endosperm nucleus have after double fertilisation?

lesson.title: Leaf se PEN tak: sets ko track karo
lesson.concept: Primary endosperm nucleus mein ek male gamete aur dono polar nuclei ke haploid sets judte hain.
lesson.scene_title: Syngamy aur triple fusion ke alag raaste
lesson.asked: Double fertilisation ke baad primary endosperm nucleus mein kitne chromosomes honge?
assumptions: Plant diploid hai aur gametes normally reduced hain.
Typical embryo sac mein har polar nucleus haploid hai.
Count PEN banne ke turant baad ka hai.
objectives: Somatic chromosome count se haploid count nikaalna.
Syngamy aur triple fusion ke participants alag karna.

prerequisites.why: Diploid mein do chromosome sets, haploid mein ek set hota hai.
Meiosis ploidy aadhi karti hai; embryo sac ki mitotic divisions haploid ploidy banaye rakhti hain.
Ek central cell mein dono polar nuclei maujood hote hain.

evidence.idea: Meiosis megaspores banati hai; functional megaspore ki mitotic divisions embryo sac banati hain.
Dono polar nuclei large central cell mein hote hain.
Male gamete aur egg nucleus ki syngamy diploid zygote banati hai.
Doosra male gamete dono polar nuclei se fuse karke triploid PEN banata hai; central cell endosperm banati hai.

stages.title: Given aur target alag hain
stages.text: Leaf ka count diya hai; PEN ka count nikaalna hai.

beats.say: Leaf cell mein 20 chromosomes hain, lekin sawaal primary endosperm nucleus ka count poochhta hai.
beats.voice: लीफ़ सेल में 20 क्रोमोसोम्स हैं, लेकिन सवाल प्राइमरी एंडोस्पर्म न्यूक्लियस का काउंट पूछता है।

beats.say: Pehle yeh pehchaano ki diya hua count poori somatic cell ka hai, gamete ka nahi.
beats.voice: पहले यह पहचानो कि दिया हुआ काउंट पूरी सोमैटिक सेल का है, गैमीट का नहीं।

stages.title: Double shabd ka jaal
stages.text: Double fertilisation do fusion events hain, chromosome count ko double karna nahi.

beats.say: Double sunke leaf ka count double kar doge, toh fusion ke actual partners chhoot jaayenge.
beats.voice: डबल सुनके लीफ़ का काउंट डबल कर दोगे, तो फ़्यूज़न के ऐक्चुअल पार्टनर्स छूट जाएँगे।

beats.say: Dono male gametes ek hi nucleus mein nahi judte; unke fusion ke raaste alag hain.
beats.voice: दोनों मेल गैमीट्स एक ही न्यूक्लियस में नहीं जुड़ते; उनके फ़्यूज़न के रास्ते अलग हैं।

stages.title: Har participant ka contribution
stages.text: Har gamete aur har polar nucleus ek haploid set deta hai.

beats.say: Leaf mein do chromosome sets hain; meiosis ploidy aadhi karti hai, mitosis use banaye rakhti hai.
beats.voice: लीफ़ में दो क्रोमोसोम सेट्स हैं; मीयोसिस प्लॉइडी आधी करती है, माइटोसिस उसे बनाए रखती है।

beats.say: Central cell ke andar dono polar nuclei dekho; PEN ke liye inke saath kaun judega?
beats.voice: सेंट्रल सेल के अंदर दोनों पोलर न्यूक्लिआई देखो; पी ई एन के लिए इनके साथ कौन जुड़ेगा?

stages.title: Pehle haploid count, phir fusion
stages.text: 20 ko do sets mein baanto, phir target nucleus ke contributions jodo.

beats.say: Do sets mein 20 chromosomes hain, isliye ek set mein 10 chromosomes aate hain.
beats.voice: दो सेट्स में 20 क्रोमोसोम्स हैं, इसलिए एक सेट में 10 क्रोमोसोम्स आते हैं।

beats.say: Egg aur ek male gamete ke sets judne se diploid zygote banta hai, PEN nahi.
beats.voice: एग और एक मेल गैमीट के सेट्स जुड़ने से डिप्लॉइड ज़ाइगोट बनता है, पी ई एन नहीं।

beats.say: Ab doosre male gamete aur dono polar nuclei ko dekho; fusion se pehle total predict karo.
beats.voice: अब दूसरे मेल गैमीट और दोनों पोलर न्यूक्लिआई को देखो; फ़्यूज़न से पहले टोटल प्रिडिक्ट करो।

beats.say: Har participant ke 10 chromosomes judte hain; 10 plus 10 plus 10 se PEN mein 30 milte hain.
beats.voice: हर पार्टिसिपेंट के 10 क्रोमोसोम्स जुड़ते हैं; 10 प्लस 10 प्लस 10 से पी ई एन में 30 मिलते हैं।

beats.say: Isliye option 3 sahi hai; hum ek nucleus ke chromosomes gin rahe hain, cells nahi.
beats.voice: इसलिए ऑप्शन 3 सही है; हम एक न्यूक्लियस के क्रोमोसोम्स गिन रहे हैं, सेल्स नहीं।

stages.title: Sirf target badlo
stages.text: Isi plant mein ab zygote ka chromosome count khud nikaalo.

beats.say: Leaf ka count wahi rakho, lekin ab zygote poochha hai; uske participants se jawaab nikaalo.
beats.voice: लीफ़ का काउंट वही रखो, लेकिन अब ज़ाइगोट पूछा है; उसके पार्टिसिपेंट्स से जवाब निकालो।

beats.say: Zygote mein egg aur male gamete hi judte hain; target badla toh contributions bhi badal gaye.
beats.voice: ज़ाइगोट में एग और मेल गैमीट ही जुड़ते हैं; टारगेट बदला तो कॉन्ट्रिब्यूशन्स भी बदल गए।

details.title: Alag partners, alag products
details.text: PEN mein egg shaamil nahi hota. Male gametes alag fusion events mein jaate hain.
chain: Egg aur polar nuclei alag targets hain
Ek gamete egg se, doosra dono polar nuclei se judta hai
Syngamy zygote aur triple fusion PEN banati hai

details.title: Chromosome sets ka hisaab
details.text: Leaf ke do sets mein 20 chromosomes hain. Har haploid contribution mein 10 chromosomes hain.
chain: PEN ke liye teen haploid contributions judte hain

gates.prompt: Leaf cell ka 20 kaunsa count hai?

wrong.why: Leaf somatic cell hai; uska chromosome count gamete ka haploid count nahi hai.

gates.why: Leaf ke count mein do chromosome sets shaamil hain.

choices: Ek male gamete aur dono polar nuclei
Dono male gametes aur dono polar nuclei

wrong.why: Egg aur male gamete ki syngamy zygote banati hai, PEN nahi.
Ek male gamete egg se fuse hota hai; dono central cell mein contribute nahi karte.

gates.why: Triple fusion mein ek paternal aur do maternal haploid sets judte hain.

gates.prompt: Triple fusion ke baad PEN mein kitne chromosomes honge?

wrong.why: Yeh sirf ek haploid participant ka count hai; fusion partners abhi jodne hain.
Tumne sirf do haploid contributions gine; PEN mein teen judte hain.
Double fertilisation do events batata hai, leaf count ko double karne ka operation nahi.
Leaf count ko do se baanto, phir teen haploid contributions jodo.

gates.why: Male gamete aur dono polar nuclei ke 10 chromosomes judkar 30 bante hain.

gates.prompt: Isi plant ke zygote ka chromosome count batao.

wrong.why: Yeh ek gamete ka count hai; zygote mein egg ka contribution bhi judta hai.
Tumne PEN ka count zygote par laga diya; syngamy mein polar nuclei nahi judte.
Zygote ke liye egg aur sirf ek male gamete ke contributions jodo.

gates.why: Egg aur male gamete ke 10 + 10 chromosomes se zygote mein 20 bante hain.

board.note: Leaf count ka aadha har haploid participant ka contribution hai; egg aur male gamete milkar diploid zygote banate hain.
PEN ke liye ek male gamete aur dono polar nuclei ke haploid chromosome contributions jodte hain.

diagnoses.title: 10: haploid par ruk gaye
diagnoses.why: Aadha karna sahi shuruaat hai, lekin PEN mein fusion partners ke contributions bhi jodne hain.

diagnoses.title: 20: zygote wala hisaab
diagnoses.why: Do haploid sets zygote banate hain; PEN mein teen haploid sets hote hain.

diagnoses.title: 30: sahi participants jode
diagnoses.why: Ek male gamete aur dono polar nuclei ke 10 + 10 + 10 chromosomes judte hain.

diagnoses.title: 40: double ko multiplier maana
diagnoses.why: Double fertilisation do fusion events ka naam hai, chromosome count doubling ka nahi.

families.title: Target zygote
families.question: Isi plant ki leaf cell mein 20 chromosomes hain. Zygote mein kitne honge?
families.why: Syngamy mein egg aur ek male gamete ke haploid sets judte hain.

families.title: Maternal aur paternal shares
families.question: PEN mein maternal:paternal chromosome contribution ka ratio kya hai?
families.why: Dono polar nuclei maternal contributions dete hain; male gamete ek paternal contribution deta hai.

lesson.recap: Leaf: do sets mein 20, toh haploid count 10. PEN: male gamete aur dono polar nuclei, yani 10 + 10 + 10 = 30 chromosomes. Option 3.
limitations: Typical diploid plant aur typical embryo sac tak model limited hai.
Central cell ka sets=0 container bookkeeping hai; uska chromosome material polar nuclei mein represented hai.
Scene complete embryo sac cell ya nucleus census ke liye nahi hai.
